title: Donda
description: The cover art for Donda is a blank, almost black space. Amidst the rollout of the album, the color black had made frequent appearances. During the second listening party for the album, which happened on August 5, 2021, at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, hundreds of performers had all dressed in nothing, but black, including Kanye himself. Reportedly, the staff of the stadium, chefs, as well as all engineers were required to wear black as well for a period of time. Donning dark colors for mourning has been strongly associated with death and loss for centuries in the west and is a practice believed to date back to the Roman times. Not actually black, but #020305.

title: Padded Denim Jacket
description:
Background: Gap's redesigned Padded Denim Jacket with taped notes for production, the color is similar to the original color of Giali's Jacket.

Demna and Balenciaga's version was originally based on Giali's Padded Denim Jacket. Gap had redesigned it, and it was made more similar to the altered version of the Gilal Padded Denim Jacket Ye wore during the last half of the Free Larry Hoover Benefit Concert on December 9th, 2021.

Gap had changed the fit of the jacket entirely—removing the cropped length, the elongated sleeves, and reducing the heavy distressing. Despite these changes, there were also many differences between the retail versions themselves, including padding thickness, distressing style, and wash/color.
